steps.text: Pointed to the real estate taxes line in Operating Statement FY2025 - Cedar Row Apartments and in Form 8825 (rental real estate, tax return).
Same property and period (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31): 27,200 vs 41,800, a difference of 14,600.
Working value 41,800 from Form 8825 (rental real estate, tax return): a filed return outranks a borrower-prepared statement for the same period (example policy).
Re-ran every rule with each value: Debt service coverage pass (1.2896) with the statement vs fail (1.2162) with the return (>= 1.25x).

NOI bridge: statement NOI 256,600.40 vs Form 8825 line 19 37,050, a gap of 219,550.40. Catalog bridges explain 204,950 (interest 106,850, depreciation 98,100 (ties: 8825 line 14 = 4562 line 22 = 98100)). Of the 14,600.40 left, this line accounts for 14,600 and rounding for the rest. Insurance is also 14,600, but it agrees on both documents, so it is not the cause.

Investigator suggestion (unverified, cannot resolve the card): The Form 8825 likely includes the full FY2025 real estate tax liability, while the operating statement may reflect only taxes paid or accrued to date or exclude certain tax components, resulting in the lower $27,200 figure.

hypothesis.hypothesis: The Form 8825 likely includes the full FY2025 real estate tax liability, while the operating statement may reflect only taxes paid or accrued to date or exclude certain tax components, resulting in the lower $27,200 figure.
steps: Obtain the official property tax bill or assessment for Cedar Row Apartments for FY2025
Compare the tax periods and amounts reported on the operating statement versus the Form 8825
Determine whether the operating statement records cash paid versus accrued expense
Check for any tax credits, abatements, or allocations that might reduce the amount shown on the operating statement
Review the borrower’s accounting policy for recognizing real estate taxes
hypothesis.verify_with: Official FY2025 property tax bill/assessment for Cedar Row Apartments
